This used to be my favorite place to buy dresses and I always recommended it. After my last visit, I will never step inside again.

We found a suit we were fully ready to purchase. We simply asked about minor tailoring adjustments and mentioned that the white pants were slightly transparent. Instead of helping, the CFC store manager, Maria, immediately responded with attitude and arrogance. She told us that if it is not our style then it is not for us and that many popular people wear it, so the problem is ours and not the design.

When I asked for the tailor to come so I could show the adjustments I wanted, she refused to even let him see the suit and shut the discussion down completely.

Her manner was dismissive, condescending, and openly disrespectful. There was no attempt to assist, no professionalism, and no basic courtesy. The whole interaction felt uncomfortable and unwelcoming rather than a customer service experience.

A store manager represents the brand, and this behavior reflected extremely poorly on it. Because of this experience I will not return and I will actively warn anyone who asks me about this store.

One of the worst retail experiences I have had.
